title: Actions related to transmission of RRCSetupRequest message

entities.name: RRC Setup Request
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate RRC connection establishment

entities.name: ue-Identity
entities.description: Identity field in RRCSetupRequest message containing either ng-5G-S-TMSI-Part1 or random value

entities.name: establishmentCause
entities.description: Cause field in RRCSetupRequest indicating reason for connection establishment

entities.name: 5G-S-TMSI provided by upper layers
entities.description: Condition where upper layers provide a 5G-S-TMSI, typically when UE is registered in current TA

entities.name: Release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication
entities.description: Condition where RRC connection establishment results from release with redirect containing mpsPriorityIndication

entities.name: Cell re-selection conditions fulfilled
entities.description: Conditions where cell re-selection evaluation determines re-selection is needed

entities.name: Continue cell re-selection measurements
entities.description: UE behavior to continue performing measurements and evaluation for cell re-selection during RRC connection establishment

entities.name: Perform cell re-selection
entities.description: UE behavior to execute cell re-selection procedure when conditions are met

relations.description: RRCSetupRequest message contains ue-Identity information element
RRCSetupRequest message contains establishmentCause information element
Condition of 5G-S-TMSI availability determines how ue-Identity is set
Condition of release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication determines establishmentCause value
Fulfillment of cell re-selection conditions establishes the need to perform cell re-selection
